meta.name: workflow_operating_instructions_fastgen_only
meta.purpose: Operating memory for the FastGen-only workflow: SRT segmentation, image generation, slideshow assembly, and publishing assets without VNonStop animation.

global_principles.primary_rule: Always derive the visual pipeline from the real audio timing, not from a rewritten literary script.
global_principles.timing_rule: First create SRT from the real audio. Only after that generate prompts and build the shot plan.
global_principles.consistency_rule: Keep visual continuity by using stable character references and by preserving shot order from the timeline.
global_principles.source_of_truth_rule: For montage and automation, treat project, scene_plan, and timeline/manifest files as the source of truth, not ad hoc folder inspection.
global_principles.render_rule: In fastgen_only mode, use normalized still images for every shot and go directly from image generation to slideshow assembly.

policy: Use the real audio/SRT text as the base for prompt timing.
Split long timed segments so no still frame is held longer than 5 seconds.
The shot plan must be computed before generating the final production set of images.

prompt_generation_rules.style: Realistic, cinematic, suitable for still generation and slideshow montage.
important_rules: Do not attach all character references to every prompt.
Attach only the references actually needed for that shot.
If a shot has no recurring character, use no character reference.
Prompts must remain optimized for still-image generation, not motion prompting.
Generate the correct total number of shots after the max-5-second split logic is done.
Normalize all images before slideshow assembly.
Do not leave coverage gaps and hope montage can hide them later.

rules: After normalized images are ready, move directly into slideshow assembly.
Do not wait for any animation stage.
Use the shot plan timing exactly.
Do not add zooms or reframing unless explicitly requested.

assets: thumbnail prompts and FastGen thumbnail candidates

anti_patterns_to_avoid: Do not invoke VNonStop in fastgen_only mode.
Do not keep animation-specific waits or retries in the fastgen_only run path.
Do not derive final image counts from sentence counts alone.
Do not skip image normalization before slideshow assembly.
